name: anonymize-mcp
description: Anonymize PII and redact text for GDPR using real NLP, not just regex. Czech-first, built on ÚFAL/LINDAT (MasKIT + NameTag NER) with 80+ PII patterns. Also multilingual NER across 35+ languages, morphology (UDPipe), machine translation, and spellcheck. 6 tools. Non-commercial use only. Install: pip
